request.question: How does BFS explore a graph?

sources.title: Authored traversal text
sources.text: Graph traversal includes BFS and DFS. BFS uses a FIFO queue and visits one distance layer at a time. DFS can use an explicit stack or recursion.

nodes.label: BFS
nodes.definition: Visit distance layers using a queue.
